question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT 
        id_bioguide,
        CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(term_start AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) as first_term_year
    FROM legislators_terms
    WHERE term_number = 0
),
all_terms AS (
    SELECT 
        lt.id_bioguide,
        lt.term_start,
        lt.term_end,
        lt.state,
        l.gender,
        ft.first_term_year
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    JOIN first_terms ft ON lt.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
),
legislator_retention AS (
    SELECT 
        id_bioguide,
        state,
        gender,
        -- For each interval, check if the legislator has ANY term covering that date
        MAX(CASE WHEN term_start <= (first_term_year + 0) || '-12-31' AND term_end > (first_term_year + 0) || '-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_0,
        MAX(CASE WHEN term_start <= (first_term_year + 2) || '-12-31' AND term_end > (first_term_year + 2) || '-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_2,
        MAX(CASE WHEN term_start <= (first_term_year + 4) || '-12-31' AND term_end > (first_term_year + 4) || '-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_4,
        MAX(CASE WHEN term_start <= (first_term_year + 6) || '-12-31' AND term_end > (first_term_year + 6) || '-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_6,
        MAX(CASE WHEN term_start <= (first_term_year + 8) || '-12-31' AND term_end > (first_term_year + 8) || '-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_8,
        MAX(CASE WHEN term_start <= (first_term_year + 10) || '-12-31' AND term_end > (first_term_year + 10) || '-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_10
    FROM all_terms
    GROUP BY id_bioguide, state, gender
)
SELECT state, gender, COUNT(*) as total_legislators,
       SUM(retained_0) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as retention_rate_0,
       SUM(retained_2) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as retention_rate_2,
       SUM(retained_4) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as retention_rate_4,
       SUM(retained_6) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as retention_rate_6,
       SUM(retained_8) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as retention_rate_8,
       SUM(retained_10) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as retention_rate_10
FROM legislator_retention
GROUP BY state, gender
ORDER BY state, gender
LIMIT 20
